svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female-epaulet-plain","name":"Women's Class B blue short-sleeve blouse and skirt (nametag position only) plain epaulet straps (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female; no grade)","size_in":{"w":25.1882,"h":32.9532},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2518.82,3295.32],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"The garment epaulet strap landmark polygons (epaulet_right / epaulet_left of garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female, the edge-on band 0.46 in thick of a 1.0 in strap, LIVE10-ART 2, Fig 4.8): the band itself in the shirt colour with the shirt's line tones, topstitching and a button. The regulation gives no strap dimension.","anchors":{"top_center":[1259.4099999999999,0],"bottom_center":[1259.4099999999999,3295.32],"center":[1259.4099999999999,1647.66],"left_edge":[0,1647.66],"right_edge":[2518.8199999999997,1647.66],"epaulet_plain_right_center":[562.36,296.4],"epaulet_plain_left_center":[1956.31,295.25]},"landmarks":{"epaulet_plain_right":{"x":324.91,"y":231.3,"w":474.9,"h":130.2},"epaulet_plain_left":{"x":1718.11,"y":230.8,"w":476.4,"h":128.9}},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in)","overlay_of":"garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female","documented":["the shirt and blouse have epaulets for every member (CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1 / 4.1.12.2)","shoulder cords are worn along the shoulder seam and, if the garment has an epaulet, underneath it (9.3, 9.4.1)","no grade goes on the strap itself: officers slip a gray or blue epaulet sleeve over it, NCOs and airmen wear chevrons or collar insignia"],"assumed":["strap size and shape (the traced base image does not draw it)","button size and position","topstitch inset"],"fit":{"method":"original","score":null},"grade":"accessory"}
